Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to common questions about SILENT.BIO architecture and usage.

Is SILENT.BIO really 100% free forever?

Yes. There are zero paid subscriptions, zero pro tiers, and zero feature locks. We built the architecture to run within predictable free tiers (Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare, Upstash).

How does SILENT.BIO differ from guns.lol or fakecrime.bio?

While those platforms popularised the subculture bio aesthetic, they are plagued by aggressive paywalls, heavy visual bloat, 3-6 second load times, and pay-to-win identity mechanics. SILENT.BIO provides the same expressive power (audio, effects, video, badges) with calm typography, 95+ Lighthouse speed, privacy-first analytics, and zero paywalls.

How does visitor tracking protect my privacy?

We use a daily salted SHA-256 hash that rotates every 24 hours UTC. We never set tracking cookies and we discard raw IP addresses immediately in memory.

Can I upload my own music and video backgrounds?

Yes. Audio and video backgrounds are fully supported with sensible size guidelines to ensure fast loading on mobile devices.
